execution_rule: One bounded phase at a time; one meaningful commit with tests/evidence per accepted phase. Define ordered children before a phase proves too broad. No parallel agents. Exact executable checks are selected from actual current code at phase opening.

phases.title: Reconcile baseline and parallel ownership
steps: Inspect current dev/main, all MAP/ESP/PRM worktrees and actual subscription implementation; record source versus deployment state.
Create an exclusive payment branch/worktree and declare owned/shared paths; coordinate shared mutations before editing.
Create a versioned threat/test matrix with acceptance states and existing PRM reuse.
required_checks: No foreign modifications lost or occupied branch moved.
No duplicate subscription/account/payment ownership; real shared-path coordination identified.
phases.exit: Baseline and ownership evidence is complete; no provider activity.
phases.commit_topic: docs(payments): PAY-00 reconcile baseline and ownership

phases.title: Freeze offers and lifecycle policy
steps: Define Premium and single-payer Enterprise deliverables, terms, BRL values/mappings and actual capability targets.
Freeze manual Pix and Pix Automatic as independently enabled; choose one automatic cycle scheduler.
Freeze refund/partial allocation, paid-through/grace, switching, late/excess settlement, legal/fiscal and distribution gates; record missing real catalog inputs.
required_checks: Golden policy examples cover month ends, early/late renewal, refund/dispute and method switching.
Missing actual price or unimplemented Enterprise service keeps that sale disabled; no fabricated production values.
phases.exit: Policy is explicit and unresolved commercial inputs cannot enable checkout.
phases.commit_topic: docs(payments): PAY-01 freeze offers and lifecycle policy

phases.title: Admit providers and maintained SDKs
steps: Revalidate primary sources and exact merchant/environment/resource/API contracts.
Select pinned Stripe SDK/raw-body verification and Asaas client approach after dependency/license/security review.
Record retry/idempotency capabilities per write operation, QR and automatic Pix eligibility/sandbox limitations.
required_checks: Adapter fixtures match admitted versions and unknown/additive states remain safe.
Asaas externalReference is not assumed unique; no manual crypto or undocumented status mapping.
phases.exit: Versions and provider contracts are admitted; account-dependent proof remains separate.
phases.commit_topic: docs(payments): PAY-02 admit provider contracts and SDKs

phases.title: Build pure financial and access policy
steps: Define separate order, attempt, settlement, contract, mandate, refund/dispute and grant transitions.
Implement deterministic period/currency/refund/source-allocation rules behind explicit ports.
Version provider-neutral access policy while preserving existing Play behavior and free exits.
required_checks: Golden/permutation/time-boundary cases cover every admitted state and invalid transition.
A redirect, authorization, manually paid Stripe invoice or unknown provider state cannot grant access.
phases.exit: Pure rules and preserved-source regressions pass.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-03 add deterministic billing policy

phases.title: Persist financial intents and concurrency guards
steps: Reserve current migration sequence with other efforts; add only required append-only schema/sqlc.
Persist orders, owner/customer mappings, operation hashes, cycles, inbox/outbox and grant-source identities.
Fence concurrent remote attempts and persist uncertain outcomes without network I/O inside transactions.
required_checks: Real PostGIS upgrade/replay/rollback and concurrent writers prove no duplicate local economic effect.
Crash before/after remote dispatch, webhook-before-reply, stale lease and changed-payload idempotency are tested.
phases.exit: Transactional and recovery invariants pass on actual PostgreSQL/PostGIS.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-04 persist idempotent financial intents

phases.title: Validate credentials and channel configuration
steps: Implement independent Stripe/manual-Pix/automatic-Pix and new-sales versus maintenance switches.
Bind test/live merchant, catalog, API/webhook keys and redirect origins; store sensitive references under reviewed key management.
Provide read-only redacted preflight and tested rotation paths; startup creates no financial resources.
required_checks: Missing/mixed credentials or environment refuse only unsafe channel sales.
Disabling new sales preserves accepted entitlement, webhook intake, cancellation and reconciliation.
phases.exit: Configuration failures are safe and diagnosable without secret exposure.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-05 validate provider configuration

phases.title: Create Stripe hosted card checkout
steps: Use authenticated owner, server catalog and durable intent to create/reuse the correct customer and Checkout Session.
Restrict card/offer/merchant/mode and allowlisted return origins; do not accept raw card data.
Recover ambiguous creates with stable provider keys and persisted mapping, including beyond remote dedupe retention.
required_checks: Tampered amount/customer/metadata/return URL and owner-IDOR are refused.
Two simultaneous requests, lost response and later stale retry cannot blindly create another subscription; remote ambiguity is surfaced.
phases.exit: Hosted creation and uncertain-write tests pass; redirect grants nothing.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-06 integrate Stripe hosted checkout

phases.title: Create conventional Asaas Pix orders
steps: Create or resolve owner-bound customer and charge with exact amount, expiry, correlation and bounded QR response.
Serialize creation intents and reconcile inconclusive responses before any retry.
Expose only owner status/QR and implement expired/late/duplicate-settlement policy without auto-debit consent.
required_checks: Lost create response and incomplete remote search stay uncertain rather than generating another charge.
Wrong amount/currency/customer/order, QR harvesting and foreign status reads are denied.
phases.exit: Pix order/QR flow is safe locally; provider receipt proof remains pending.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-07 integrate conventional Asaas Pix

phases.title: Receive Stripe events durably
steps: Verify bounded exact raw body with maintained SDK signature/timestamp handling and rotation.
Bind expected account/mode/version, insert minimal durable inbox before acknowledgement.
Handle duplicates/content conflicts/unknown events without invoking remote APIs in the response path.
required_checks: Forged/stale/rotated signatures, mutated raw body, wrong mode, huge JSON and duplicate-ID alteration are tested.
DB failure never returns fake delivery success; callback load has bounded resource use.
phases.exit: Authenticated durable callback contract passes adversarial tests.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-08 add Stripe webhook inbox

phases.title: Receive Asaas events durably
steps: Require separate strong webhook authToken via asaas-access-token and safe comparison over TLS.
Persist bounded events and return exact HTTP 200 only after durable acceptance.
Handle authentic unknown/additive data safely; track interrupted delivery and reactivation/reconciliation obligations.
required_checks: API key is not reused as webhook token; no invented per-body HMAC or trust in a source IP alone.
Token rotation, duplicated/conflicting events, backlog, oversized input and DB outage have meaningful tests.
phases.exit: Asaas-specific intake is durable and safe; no financial effect is trusted from payload alone.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-09 add Asaas webhook inbox

phases.title: Verify settlements and project existing access
steps: Process durable events with bounded provider lookups and canonical order/customer/merchant/mode/amount matches.
Commit financial fact, one cycle effect, source-specific access grant and durable follow-up atomically.
Extend subscription/capability ports without fake Play tokens or mandatory Play credentials for web purchases; add reconciliation.
required_checks: Reordered/delayed events, revoked grants, manual paid invoices, pending capture and wrong currency never yield invalid rights.
Real PostGIS concurrent receipt/revoke and provider-outage recovery preserve legitimate unrelated grants and local/free data.
phases.exit: Verified financial facts fund exactly the eligible local grant; all sources remain independent.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-10 project verified payment access

phases.title: Complete Stripe recurring lifecycle
steps: Handle initial action-required/decline, renewals, failed invoices, grace, cancellation and dashboard changes.
Create constrained owner-bound hosted management sessions with approved catalog operations.
Keep provider subscription and verified invoice-funded periods distinct and reconcile missed events.
required_checks: SCA/3DS/past-due/cancel/renew races and unsupported portal plan changes are covered.
A canceled renewal retains only eligible paid-through access; no new entitlement from invoice creation.
phases.exit: Complete recurring card lifecycle is locally accepted.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-11 complete Stripe recurring lifecycle

phases.title: Integrate Pix Automatic consent and authorization
steps: Implement actual admitted authorization/customer/first-payment contract with explicit consent and merchant eligibility.
Track initial paid period independently from ACTIVE/REFUSED mandate.
Implement retrieval, refusal, expiry, cancellation and privacy-safe authorization audit without assuming activation.
required_checks: Initial PAYMENT_RECEIVED plus authorization REFUSED still retains the valid first paid period but grants no future debit authority.
Foreign authorization, revoked consent, wrong customer and lost authorization reply are covered.
phases.exit: Mandate lifecycle is correct; automatic Pix remains independently disabled until external proof.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-12 integrate Pix Automatic authorization

phases.title: Complete Pix Automatic recurring cycles
steps: Implement only the selected provider-owned or application-owned cycle scheduler; never both.
Track provider-supported instruction/retry windows, received payments and account eligibility changes.
Stop future instructions on mandate cancel/expiry/ineligibility and reconcile in-flight attempts.
required_checks: Concurrent scheduler/retry workers, cancellation races and failed/deferred instructions cannot duplicate debits or grants.
Unknown remote creation/cancellation remains pending; provider account limitations remain explicit.
phases.exit: One recurring charge owner and recovery paths pass actual DB/process tests.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-13 complete Pix Automatic cycles

phases.title: Fence plan changes and cross-provider switching
steps: Implement approved next-term upgrade/downgrade/term/price transitions; reject unsupported proration explicitly.
Fence old recurring funding source before new activation and preserve original paid windows.
Reconcile simultaneous manual Pix/card/automatic payments with no duplicate grant and explicit excess-payment handling.
required_checks: Two-device/two-provider switch, unknown old cancellation, stale quote and retry-after-crash are tested.
A provider's automatic renewal and application renewal never coexist for one obligation.
phases.exit: Change and switching policies are safe under real concurrency.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-14 fence cross-provider billing changes

phases.title: Complete cancellation and account exits
steps: Implement owner-authenticated cancel/status/history/export with fresh proof for sensitive operations.
Separate stopping renewal from expiry and from payment/refund; preserve already-held data and free exits.
Record cancellation/deletion recovery, minimal financial retention and restore-safe tombstones.
required_checks: Foreign/deleted/revoked caller, logout/account switch, provider outage and restored stale outbox are covered.
Deleting an account cannot create automatic refunds or continue unnoticed billing; uncertain cancellation stays visible.
phases.exit: Account exit is durable and cannot replay remote money writes.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-15 complete billing cancellation and exits

phases.title: Complete refunds disputes and financial recovery
steps: Implement restricted original-route full/partial refund intents with concurrent refundable-balance reservations.
Reconcile pending/failed/completed refund, Stripe chargeback and Asaas Pix MED/hold lifecycles.
Provide scoped operator replay/review with fresh strong proof, reason/audit and approval policy; no arbitrary payout/manual premium endpoint.
required_checks: Concurrent refunds exceed neither original principal nor policy; lost refund reply never triggers blind second refund.
Insufficient balance, duplicate/reversed dispute, no-payment account hold and restore/replay are tested.
phases.exit: Refund/dispute effects match confirmed original payments and limited grants.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-16 handle refunds and disputes safely

phases.title: Complete single-payer Enterprise billing
steps: Bind exact implemented Enterprise offer, billed entity and authenticated payer to its allowed service/account target.
Expose owner-safe billing records and approved provider invoice/receipt references; freeze fiscal workflow.
Prevent company data/email/domain from granting team, station-management or organization privileges; refuse unimplemented offers.
required_checks: Foreign payer/order/target, product confusion, arbitrary quantity/seat override and entity substitution are denied.
Premium remains independent; no hidden tenant/representation schema is introduced.
phases.exit: Defined Enterprise billing flow passes without inventing missing business capabilities.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-17 support scoped Enterprise billing

phases.title: Close adversarial privacy and performance acceptance
steps: Execute and update the full threat matrix with retained residual risks and source-dependent proof obligations.
Verify bounded rates/retries/workers/queues, secret rotation, private retention and financial restore recovery.
Freeze then measure accepted operations, callback latency/resources, query plans and recovery load with synthetic provider fixtures.
required_checks: Immediate real PostGIS/fault/race tests cover abuse matrix; no skipped critical auth/money/privacy tests.
No PII/QR/payment URLs/keys in logs; no adverse safety/map workload regression; benchmark counts successful valid effects.
phases.exit: Required local security/consistency/performance cases pass at a pinned revision.
phases.commit_topic: test(payments): PAY-18 validate abuse privacy and capacity

phases.title: Wire actual API and worker runtime
steps: At a coordinated shared-file boundary, compose real provider clients/config, private commands, webhooks and durable jobs.
Keep startup/new-sales defaults off; define source-specific local access freshness and switches correctly.
Run real process + PostGIS journeys and affected PRM/MAP/ESP consumers; preserve route and worker isolation.
required_checks: No deployed test provider/manual grant bypass; web channels do not require Play credentials.
Process tests demonstrate callback-to-grant, restart/outage/revoke and cancellation/refund routes with all relevant gates.
phases.exit: PAY-LOCAL_READY source/runtime gate passes; no external provider acceptance inferred.
phases.commit_topic: feat(payments): PAY-19 compose verified payment runtime

phases.title: Package deployment and configuration handoff
steps: Provide redacted example configuration, independent channel switches, least-privilege secrets and read-only preflight.
Document catalog/webhook/event/version/account/eligibility/notification/fiscal setup beyond API keys.
Prepare tested backup/restore/rollback, queue recovery, key rotation, channel-disable and bounded test procedures.
required_checks: Incomplete/mixed setup refuses checkout with actionable redacted codes; secrets never cause automatic live activation.
Startup and upgrade preserve existing app/map/site behavior and pending financial maintenance.
phases.exit: PAY-CONFIG_READY has complete configuration contract and tested safe defaults.
phases.commit_topic: chore(payments): PAY-20 package secure payment operations

phases.title: Prove actual provider sandbox journeys
steps: Using securely supplied test credentials and named account setup, run actual Stripe test-mode and Asaas Sandbox checkout/callback/access paths.
Prove renewal/action-required/decline/cancel/refund, duplicate event recovery and both selected Pix modes to the extent actually supported.
Record merchant/environment/resources privately and public redacted artifact/test evidence; enumerate unsupported external proofs.
required_checks: Test-only fixtures do not count as provider integration; missing credentials/eligibility keeps this phase pending.
Real supported journeys and callbacks are verified per channel; no live-money substitution for unsupported sandbox.
phases.exit: PAY-SANDBOX_ACCEPTED only for channels with complete actual required proof.
phases.commit_topic: test(payments): PAY-21 verify provider sandbox flows

phases.title: Integrate batch and validate protected CI
steps: Coordinate latest dev/main and other workstreams; merge owned changes normally without importing unfinished map/portal code.
Run affected final acceptance once and open/reuse cumulative protected dev-to-main PR with real identifiers.
Fix CI/review failures in new commits and use guarded finish with required Quick verification only on current passing head/base.
required_checks: All required/applicable checks actually pass; changed head/base invalidates affected proof.
No force/admin/no-verify; dev retained; merged commit ancestry and scope verified.
phases.exit: PAY-INTEGRATED after actual protected merge, never from a local commit alone.
phases.commit_topic: chore(payments): PAY-22 reconcile final delivery candidate

phases.title: Validate scoped VPS test deployment and activation handoff
steps: Prepare the exact merged artifact and coordinate an Abastevo-only test-environment deployment window with map/portal owners.
Verify real HTTPS and provider test callbacks, order/payment/access/renewal/cancel/refund, resources and rollback without disrupting shared services.
Keep live sales off; document production catalog/eligibility/distribution approvals and obtain explicit live-money scope before real charges/refunds.
required_checks: PAY-VPS_TEST_ACCEPTED requires actual external test-mode functionality, not only health endpoints.
No other app/shared edge expansion/global cleanup; remaining production gates and unsupported proof stay explicit.
phases.exit: Actual test deployment accepted; commercial readiness remains channel-specific and separately authorized.
phases.commit_topic: docs(payments): PAY-23 record real VPS payment verification
